trail.name: Bearpaw and Trapper Lakes
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Leigh Lake Trailhead marker, 3.4 m from the shared NPS approach. This is a trailhead-area forecast, not the southern parking-access start or a guarantee of conditions along the entire hike.

additionalSources.note: NPS route configuration identifies the shared Leigh Lake approach and the intended out-and-back to Trapper Lake, not an added Bearpaw camping-access spur.

comparison.note: The full official NPS approach plus four connected NPS-origin USGS segments, retraced on return, total 9.333 miles, 1.4% above NPS. The route continues past the Bearpaw area to Trapper Lake; the separate Bearpaw access spur is excluded.

photo.alt: A blue lake lies beneath green forested slopes with a snow-streaked mountain beyond.
photo.permissionNote: The corresponding official activity page credits NPS Photo/A. Falgoust and displays no third-party restriction. Retain the credit and source link; no endorsement is implied. The original 6016 x 3384 JPEG was visually reviewed without upscaling.
